q_problem:
Standard cloud drives have critical security flaws:
1. Broken Access Control (IDOR): URL ID manipulation exposes other users' confidential documents.
2. Stale Permissions: Revoked access lingers for minutes due to cached tokens.
3. Malleable Logs: Database records can be modified by rogue admins.

TrustVault Solution:
- Strict Zero-Trust ACL: Validates every request server-side (0ms stale window on revocation).
- 404 on Unauthorized: Prevents document ID enumeration.
- Append-Only SHA-256 Ledger: Chained cryptographic audit trail makes tampering mathematically impossible.
q_built:
100% Implemented & Verified in Production:
- Auth & RBAC: JWT + bcrypt; distinct Admin, Owner, Viewer roles.
- Zero-Trust ACL: Instant per-user read/edit permissions; 0ms revocation window.
- Secure File Engine: Magic-byte inspection (%PDF validation; blocks disguised .exe/.html), streaming download proxy.
- Atomic Bulk Operations: High-speed bulk delete in a single database transaction.
- Cryptographic Audit Ledger: SHA-256 block chaining with PostgreSQL advisory locks (pg_advisory_xact_lock) preventing concurrency forks.
- UI & Search: React 19 SPA with multi-criteria search (title, category, date, owner).
q_run:
Prerequisites: Node.js 18+, Python 3.11+, Git

1. Clone:
git clone https://github.com/Likhitha1004/TrustVault-Instant-Revoke-Document-Vault.git && cd TrustVault-Instant-Revoke-Document-Vault

2. Backend:
cd backend && python -m venv venv && ./venv/Scripts/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000 --reload

3. Frontend:
cd ../frontend && npm install && npm run dev

4. Verify Tests:
cd ../backend && pytest tests -v
q_ai_wrong:
Critical AI flaws identified and manually fixed:
1. N+1 Query Overhead: AI used basic lazy loading (150+ queries, 1.1s latency). Refactored with joinedload/selectinload (2 queries, 82ms, 92.6% faster).
2. Audit Hash Race Condition: AI calculated hash in-memory; concurrent uploads caused ledger forks. Fixed using pg_advisory_xact_lock(77123991) for deterministic block serialization.
3. File Extension Spoofing: AI only checked .endswith('.pdf'). Implemented 2,048-byte physical magic-byte header inspection to block disguised executables.
4. IDOR Leakage: AI returned HTTP 403 on forbidden access. Enforced HTTP 404 to prevent valid UUID enumeration.
5. Slow Bulk Deletion: AI looped individual DELETE calls (150s+). Built atomic POST /api/documents/bulk-delete running in 3.82s.
